propositions: Under `-n 3 --dist worksteal`, the process-local lru_cache causes each of three xdist workers to independently re-render all 178 corpus bodies via 884 pandoc spawns, triplicating the work that serial execution performs once.
The three `test_dc_corpus_passes_two_to_five_are_byte_identical` parametrizations each recompute pass-1 renders identical to values already cached in `_rendered()`, causing redundant computation.

A session-scoped cross-worker artifact keyed by SHA-256 digest of corpus JSON, renderer source, and pandoc version/path, shared via `tmp_path_factory.getbasetemp().parent` and protected by atomic `os.mkdir` locking, reduces per-worker cache fills from three to one.
Per-stratum sharding with `PYTEST_XDIST_WORKER`-rotated probe order allows concurrent fill of different strata, reducing cold-session wall time from full-corpus to single-stratum duration.
The loser fallback deadline of 150s (below the 300s `--timeout` guard) prevents deadlock on crashed winners by allowing workers to degrade to local rendering rather than hanging.
